details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is the flagship instruction-tuned model in Alibaba's Qwen2.5-Coder family, open-sourced by the Qwen team on November 12, 2024. It is built on a 32.5-billion-parameter base pretrained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding data, and synthetic data, and is tuned for code generation, code reasoning, and code fixing while retaining general language and math ability.
advantages: Scores 73.7 on the Aider code-editing benchmark, per Qwen's Qwen2.5-Coder family announcement.
Scores 65.9 on McEval, a multi-programming-language code generation benchmark, per Qwen's family announcement.
Scores 75.2 on MdEval, a multi-language code-debugging benchmark, per Qwen's family announcement.
Pretrained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding data, and synthetic data, per Qwen's model card.
disadvantages: Text-only input and output, with no vision or audio support.
use_cases: Code generation, completion, and refactoring across multiple programming languages.
Code review, debugging, and automated code fixing.
Building coding agents and code-focused conversational assistants.

notes: Qwen's model card states this model natively supports 32,768 tokens, extendable to 131,072 via YaRN scaling, which is larger than the catalog's 4,096-token figure for this entry; kept the catalog's value and left context length out of the write-up rather than restate a different number. A separate catalog entry (qwen2p5-coder-32b-instruct-128k) covers the same model served with the extended 131,072-token window.
